decision.msg: Map: quiet = state bucket in_flight|stale + last line >2 h (landed never quiet); unmerged/merged-not-landed stay git checks over the state's listed rows (branch read from the listed dir via SessionIndex.reduce, whether it landed is the state's bucket); no-outcome = bucket landed + empty line; asks join on state.agents. Window = state tasks whose last or started falls in the 10 days.
decision.alt: adding a branch field to State.fold/row (rejected: one more read per listed dir is cheap, State stays untouched)

decision.msg: Source: ai/state.json when under a minute old, else a fresh State.snapshot({full:true}) with the registry (nothing written; State has no collect()). The cached file is rarely that fresh from a cron-ish tick, so the usual path is one ~6 s build.
decision.alt: always rebuild (same cost, but a hot Servex watcher already keeps the file fresh)

log.msg: Measurement: of the 30 rows the old reader called quiet, 26 survive (24 stale in state.json, 2 moved day dirs 10/17->10/16 and are stale there), 4 drop out (bucket stopped: ai-system-docs, accounting, worktree-pool-ready, notifications-lab). None of the 30 is landed: the brief's 'landed (finish line)' premise does not hold, they are stale. The count rises 30 -> 192 quiet because the state sees every depth (981 tasks in the window vs 164), not because more broke.

Check: healthy 743 + flagged 238 = 981 = the state's tasks in the 10-day window, printed by the script; a mismatch prints both and exits 1. Flagged counts before (card 10-18): 48 (0 unmerged, 0 merged-not-landed, 30 quiet, 1 no-outcome, 17 asks); after (this build): 255 flag-kinds (192 quiet, 46 no-outcome, 17 asks).

assign.title: Follow-up: counted by the one state
assign.outcome:
**FollowUp now reads the one state.** `Server/FollowUp.mjs` takes its tasks, buckets and agents from `State` (ai/state.json when under a minute old, else a fresh snapshot); its own folder walk and its own "landed" test are gone.

- [x] each kind mapped to the state, in this log and in [the page](/framework/ai/doc/follow-up.md) ("How each row is counted")
- [x] of the 30 old "quiet" rows, 26 survive (all `stale`; none was actually landed) and 4 drop out (`stopped`)
- [x] same card and doc shape, plus the line "counted by the one state"
- [x] healthy 743 + flagged 238 = 981 = the state's tasks in the 10-day window; a mismatch prints both numbers and exits 1
- [x] before/after flagged: 48 before (30 quiet, 1 no outcome, 17 asks), 255 after (192 quiet, 46 no outcome, 17 asks); the rise is the state seeing every depth (981 tasks vs 164), not more breakage

Left: TaskLoop runs FollowUp as a fresh child process once a day, so no Servex restart is needed. The 192 stale tasks are the owner's to close or resume.
